settings.title: Returns & Exchanges
settings.subtitle: We want you to love your Performance Skins. If they're not right, here's how returns and exchanges work.
settings.policy_text:
We accept returns within 30 days of delivery on items in new, sellable condition. Items must be unworn (other than trying on indoors) and in original packaging.

This is a standard return policy. Items showing signs of wear, outdoor use, or studio use are not eligible for return.
settings.exchange_text: Need a different size? We offer free shipping on size exchanges within 30 days of purchase. Contact our support team to initiate an exchange — we'll send you a prepaid return label and ship your new size as soon as we receive the original.
settings.international_text: International customers: send a photo of the item to our support team. For defects, no return shipping is required. For size exchanges, customer pays return shipping. We cover replacement shipping domestically; international replacement shipping is at customer's cost.

settings.title: Contact Support
settings.description: Email our support team with your order number to request a return or exchange.

settings.title: Receive Return Label
settings.description: We'll email you a prepaid return shipping label (domestic exchanges) or return instructions.

settings.title: Ship It Back
settings.description: Pack your Performance Skins in original packaging and drop off at any FedEx location.

settings.title: Refund or Exchange
settings.description: Refunds process within 5-7 business days of receiving your return. Exchanges ship immediately upon receipt.

settings.question: Can I return worn Performance Skins?
settings.answer: No. Returns are accepted only on items in new, sellable condition — unworn other than trying on indoors. Items showing signs of wear are not eligible. If you have a manufacturing defect, see our warranty page.

settings.question: How long do refunds take?
settings.answer: Refunds process within 5-7 business days of receiving your return. Depending on your payment method, it may take an additional 3-5 days to appear on your statement.

settings.question: Is there a restocking fee?
settings.answer: No restocking fees on standard returns within the 30-day window for items in new, sellable condition.

settings.question: What if I received a defective pair?
settings.answer: Defective items are handled through our 90-day warranty, not the standard return policy. Visit our warranty page or contact support with photos of the defect.

settings.title: We're here for you.
settings.body: Contact support for return questions. We respond within 24-48 hours.
